title: Florida Man Earns Attempted Murder Charge After Doing This
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Florida man turning a traffic stop in a felony charge of attempted murder. Fort Walton Beach police said officers asked to search Antonio Betts’s car after he allegedly gave out a false name and smelled of narcotics. Instead of getting out of the car, Betts allegedly sped off while both officers were trying to remove him from the vehicle. Watch the incident unfold and find out what to Betts on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
